title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

title: Coordenador de Manutenção
description:
Para a posição de Coordenador de Manutenção, a atuação será voltada ao suporte das operações, com foco no acompanhamento de rotinas administrativas e operacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, programar e controlar as atividades de manutenção e grandes paradas de acordo com o programa de manutenção e com as prioridades operacionais;
  • Coordenar e garantir recursos humanos, materiais, peças, ferramentas e insumos necessários para a execução das tarefas de manutenção que necessitam do suporte de terra;
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos, esboços, tabelas, especificações técnicas, manuais ou instruções para validar ajustes, normas, tolerâncias e tudo que for necessário para execução do seu trabalho; Levantar fatos e dados relacionados a eventos para investigação (RCA);
  • Revisar e aprovar os serviços executados pelos fornecedores;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência no setor marítimo ou offshore.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em auditorias de sociedades classificadoras (ABS e DNV);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Noções em Ciências navais e Navegação, Mecânica de propulsores e Lemes, Máquinas navais, Turbinas Sistemas de automação, Sistema de geração de energia, Sistemas hidráulicos, sistema de arrefecimento, Eletrônica, comunicação de rádios VHF e SSB e sistema Vsat;
  • Conhecimento em Serviços técnicos de produção, manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, vedações, montagens, conhecimento de sistemas offshore e operações dentro dos padrões técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de causa raíz e/ou ferramentas de qualidade: 5W2H, diagrama de Ishikawa, diagrama de Pareto.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .

  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Especialista Azure
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos e Atividades


• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc
  • Identify inefficiencies and turn them into systems



What We’re Looking For


  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities:

·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.

·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .

·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.

·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .

·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.

·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.

·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .

·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.

·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .

·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .

Required Qualifications:

·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .

·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .

·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .

·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior (Plataforma)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior, com forte viés em backend , para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Mid-Level+ (3+ years)


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
